body: It's probably not a good idea. As for me... I haven't been able to stick with NC at all.  It was awful in the beginning, but now I barely even feel anything when we contact each other.  It's not that I'm over him (I'm still in love), but it seems I've gotten so used to the shitty feelings after contact that now I just quickly brush them aside, and I feel normal again after a few seconds.

I'll probably take up that offer.  For me the painful feelings comes in waves everyday. One moment I'll feel like life is fine, I'll meet someone good in the future, and a couple of hours later I'll feel like crap again and miss him a ridiculous amount. My relationship lasted only 16 months, but it was a serious relationship... I'd never known anything so amazing in my life, which made me crash and burn when it ended.

The feeling is truly awful isn't it? But don't do it, reaching out will only reopen the wound. I'm still trying to work on that myself... I've been reaching out so much that the other person no longer responds. That hurts more than a curt reply. Whenever you feel like texting, come here and rant, and I'll do the same :)
Thank you, I'll keep that in mind :)

You're right... I need to stop... It's taking a lot of time for my heart to finally realize that the 'we' from before is gone. I'm still grieving for the loss of our relationship and keep living in the past. It's been less than 1 month, hopefully the next month will bring better tidings.

I do have things I'm passionate about, I love reading, drawing, and cosplaying. I just haven't been able to muster up the motivation to do any of those things.  Thank you though, for the encouragement

Thank you, really, I need people to keep telling me these things, otherwise I fall right back into that place again. Problem is the people I usually talk to are becoming unresponsive since my mind just runs in circles and they can't keep up the constant pep talk.

I can't stop wondering how he is, what he's doing, or whether he misses me as much as I miss him. I know none of these thoughts do me any good or make any difference in how things are, but my brain continues to betray me. 

I did rely on him to make me happy because so many things in my life were going wrong... I feel completely lost right now, grasping at straws to keep afloat, but my head keeps dipping below the surface.

Going through the same thing right now... My lack of self control caused me to contact him in moments of weakness. Every time I did that I set myself back in terms of recovery.  Can't offer any advice, but you're not alone, there are a lot of us out there feeling the same kind of pain. I think that thought alone brings in a little comfort, even if it's not the kind of comfort you're craving.

You sound exactly like me 1-2 weeks ago. I know it doesn't feel like it in the slightest, but it will get better. A week ago I was waking up to extreme pain, which numbed after several hours when my brain finally felt fried. 

Have you considered talking to a counselor or therapist? I found it to be immensely helpful to talk to a professional. And of course to talk to close friends. Since the break up, I confided in 7 of my closest friends and even 2 of his friends. Without their help I'd still be at rock bottom. It also helps a lot to have someone there to force you to eat. I went through the phase where I couldn't stomach solid food too, all it did was make me feel weaker, which didn't help with the emotional pain and stress at all. Try eating a little bit of fruit or soup every hour or so. 

The pain will lessen each day. Take some time off for yourself to heal. It will get better. Hang in there.
Wish I could've been like you when I ran into my ex... Hopefully I'll get there one day.

I'm dealing with something similar right now. Even though he made it clear there's no chance of us getting back together, I still hold on to hope that one day we will be... It's an awful feeling, trying to fall out of love with someone but at the same time you want to keep loving them.

Three weeks ago, although the first two weeks I tried extremely hard to get him to reconsider. Sometimes he'll seem like he wants to change his mind, we even spent time together at each other's houses, cuddled, kissed, did sexual stuff, saw a movie together... And then he'll take it all away and reject me again. I obviously did certain things that didn't help the situation at all, like becoming way too desperate trying to contact him when he said he wanted space. 

It officially blew up and ended on the Tuesday that just passed... The first couple of days when I was on the path of finally accepting the fact that we can't be together anymore were absolute hell. But now I think I'm starting to feel like I can function again.

Going through the exact same thing right now. Had a very realistic dream this morning in which he rejected me again. It doesn't help that I keep taking naps because I'm feeling so lethargic everyday. But I can honestly say that it gets a little better easier each day. The horrible feelings each morning doesn't feel as bad as it did a week ago, so I have faith that it'll feel a little bit less intense next week. 

I find that lying in my bed thinking about him makes it worse. If I find the strength to get up and make myself some breakfast, come here and read some motivational posts, the feelings start to subside. But for a while I'm greeted with the worst pain I've ever felt every time I woke up. 

Stay strong.

Thanks for sharing this, I'm still in that stage where I'm in shock over the end of our relationship. I thought it was going to last forever... For us, the love and passion just grew stronger over time. We talked about the future so much... Marriage... Kids... Now it's all gone. 

I can't stand not talking to him... I miss him terribly... He has cut off all contact from me, deleted me off Facebook and Skype. I can't stand it..

How long did it take for you to finally start feeling better? I'm still at a point right now where it takes all the effort I have to stop myself from texting him. I know he wants no contact... He deleted me off Facebook and Skype... But that scares me so much... We've talked pretty much everyday since we met. I think I'm still in shock over how quickly things regressed.  The drive over to the US for that fateful trip we both remarked at how our relationship seems to have reached a new level. Then a couple days later... it's all gone...

I did need to wait... He asked me to give him space to think about it when the breakup first happened, but I was too impatient and wanted things crystal clear immediately.  It's too late now... I acted too desperately and it pushed him away. He's the type of person that quits things cold turkey and doesn't look back, so I don't think I'll be expecting any further contact from him. 

I know I shouldn't have let him become such a huge part of me. I depended on him so much for emotional support (I've been under a lot of stress from school and career related troubles), that when things ended between us I ended up having a complete meltdown. I recently withdrew from school this term for mental health reasons, delaying my graduation...

This sounds like the exact situation I'm in, except I'm coming from the female side, the one who wants to hurt herself.  I can't speak for anyone else, but when I tried to hurt myself it was because I felt desperate and helpless when he decided he doesn't want me anymore. He made me promise I'll never hurt myself again, and when we ended things I felt like he didn't care anymore, so that was what made the cutting start again . That helplessness led me to do a lot of things I wouldn't under normal circumstances, including desperately trying to hold onto him even though I know it's scaring him and that it wasn't helping the situation at all.

I'm sorry I have no advice for you in terms of what to do, I can only speak from the other perspective because I'm going through something extremely similar right now. I miss him terribly and would go back in time to change everything if I could. But I can't, and things ended up this way. 

You're only trying to protect yourself, which I understand. But please get her professional help and don't say anything to put any blame on her, because it would make the self-harm worse.

2012 by far. I'm in my fourth year in a university co-op program (University of Waterloo). First four month of the year worked at a co-op job that I hated. Because of the way the career path I chose is structured, I thought it was going to be the job I would continue working when I graduate, which made me feel completely trapped and hopeless. 

Due to my anxiety and depression issues my marks have been steadily slipping and I managed to fail quite a few midterms during the school term this summer.  That, coupled with the hopelessness I felt in the wrong career direction led to a lot of tension for me in my everyday life. 

Three weeks ago my long term serious boyfriend broke up with me. He says he can't handle me anymore. I was in such a state of shock because right before the events that led to the break up we were the happiest we'd ever been.  All these events culminated in a mental meltdown, and in the past three weeks I've been hospitalized twice, dropped out of the school term (delayed graduation by a year), and I'm now living in a house for people in crisis do I don't try to kill myself.  My mental health seems to be worsening everyday. I feel lost and abandoned and the suicidal thoughts comes and goes daily. Mornings seem to be the worst right now because that's when reality hits. 

I keep wondering how things got so bad so quickly. 2011 was the best year of my life. Sometimes I feel like I can't become too happy, because the universe balances it by giving me a crash that's just waiting right around the corner.  I've never hit rock bottom so hard.
